# osapi skill

Show the agent skills that this binary has. `osapi cli command get --name skill`
shows the same.

## Group

|             |                                            |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | skill                                      |
| Description | Show the agent skills that this binary has |

|             |                                      |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Method      | list                                 |
| Description | List the skills that this binary has |

## [osapi skill get](../../usage/cli/skill/get.md)

|             |                                              |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| Method      | get                                          |
| Description | Print a skill, or one of its reference files |
| Refuses     | no name                                      |

### Flags (2)

| FLAG        | TYPE   | VALIDATE  | HELP                                                     |

| --name      | string | required  | Name of the skill                                        |
| --reference | string | omitempty | A reference file of the skill, relative to its directory |
